methods.BACKHAUL_DESC: High-performance reverse tunnel with multiplexing and congestion control.
methods.FRP_DESC: Feature-rich reverse proxy with TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS, STCP and XTCP.
methods.GOST_DESC: Lightweight high-speed TCP/UDP relay for restricted networks.
methods.SSH_DESC: Local, remote and dynamic port forwarding over SSH.
methods.PORT_FORWARD_DESC: Bidirectional TCP and UDP port forwarding rules.
methods.DIRECT_DESC: Simplest forward on one server: listen on a port, send to a service. No dial-out needed.
methods.REVERSE_DESC: One-click SSH reverse forward (-R with auto-reconnect). Iran dials out, Foreign exposes the port. TCP only.
methods.XUI_DESC: Link an X-UI / 3X-UI panel inbound. No extra process, checked over HTTPS.

wizard.title: Create a tunnel
wizard.subtitle: Set up a tunnel in a few steps
wizard.singleNodeHint: This tunnel runs on a single node — pick the server that should run it.
wizard.invalidNodes: Please select an Iran node and a Foreign node

wizard.name: Tunnel name

wizard.portMapHint: Local service port ↔ public remote port

wizard.bidirectionalHint: Run a relay on both nodes
wizard.dashboardHint: FRP status dashboard on the Foreign node
wizard.emptyRules: Add at least one port-forwarding rule
wizard.emptyProxies: Add at least one FRP proxy
wizard.sshIncomplete: SSH needs a host, username, local port and remote port
wizard.directHint: One server only. Best when the service is directly reachable. Runs on the Foreign node.
wizard.reverseHint: Runs on the Iran node: an SSH reverse forward (-R) dials out to Foreign, so it works behind NAT/firewall. Leave the host empty to use the selected Foreign node. TCP only.
wizard.reverseListenHint: Public port on the Foreign node
wizard.xrayHint: Runs xray-core. Copy the inbound credentials from your X-UI / 3X-UI panel into these fields.
wizard.xrayUuidHint: UUID (VLESS/VMess) or password (Trojan/Shadowsocks) from the 3X-UI inbound.
wizard.xuiHint: Links an existing X-UI / 3X-UI inbound. No tunnel process runs here — the panel checks the 3X-UI API over HTTPS.
wizard.xuiIncomplete: Panel URL, username and password are required
wizard.freePortFail: Could not fetch a free port — type one manually
wizard.autoReconnectHint: Restarts the SSH client automatically when the link drops. Falls back to plain ssh if autossh is not installed on the node.
